You may be missing it when you look down on certain people.

September 18 2 min read Latunde Akin

You may be missing it when you look down on certain people.
Certain people in respect of what they command behind your back without you suspecting they are the one behind it.
People that hardly sleep at night, when others are sleeping. Try and not treat such people cheaply.
They may not look like it now,but their time of preparation every night can't go without a good result or a manifestation of breaking forth into greatness.
First try to encourage a hardworking person no matter how unyielding what they do is now.
Secondly, try to fear a man who prays a lot because power can change hands in his life at any moment.
When you see people who look unserious, don't always conclude they're not serious. You don't know they may be using unseriouness to cover up seriousness..
People you deliberately ignore today because they are not good for you may become someone you will need tomorrow.
Be very sensitive in your spirit to recognise intrinsic factors or qualities in people rather than people's current bad situation.
I have seen cases where a man who dictate others success before God on his knees were despised by the same people he is bending his knees for. And simply because those people didn't know he isn't sleeping because of them, they ignore him as if he is a parasite. Then table gradually turns and God announces Himself in his life.
What people do in the secret to succeed is what matters most and not what people see outwardly.
You need to be very smart at having smooth human relationship with people that works whilst others are sleeping. Such people may even be vulnerable to you in terms of need, but they are definitely up to something worthwhile if you discovered they don't sleep while others sleep.
Invest in such people without complaining because you will definitely be happy you did later on.
Men who despise others,learn not to do that again. If you don't have anything to add to others in terms of encouragement, please don't subtract from their confidence by ignoring them.
Treat people well now so you won't later enter into a well you dug by yourself.
Thank you for reading. I hope you can read a little bit deeper than those words.
We will always be happy seeing lives we have touched positively and not negatively.
God bless us.
Your brother
Latunde Akin
